title: AIP-C01 Hands-on Labs: Series Catalog
html:
AIP-C01 Hands-on Labs: Series Catalog

Every domain, task and skill of the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional exam, in exam-guide order, with a link to each post.

AIP-C01 Hands-on Labs · Series catalog. Bookmark this page: it lists every post in the order of the official exam guide.

The AIP-C01 Hands-on Labs series follows the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional exam guide exactly. The guide has five domains; each domain has tasks; each task has skills. There is one post per skill, then one exam-notes post per task. This catalog lists them all, in order, so you can jump straight to any skill. Click a title to open the post.

How to use this catalog

  • New to the series? Start with AIP-C01 Hands-on Labs: Start Here. It explains how the posts work and what you need for the labs.
  • Studying in order? Work down the list: every skill post in a task, then that task’s exam notes.
  • Revising? Read only the exam-notes post at the end of each task.
  • Each post is marked Notes (read, no AWS account needed), Lab (hands-on, with files on GitHub) or Exam notes (scenarios, traps and trigger words for the whole task).
  • Unfamiliar service? Look it up in AIP-C01 Hands-on Labs: AWS Services Reference.

Start here

  1. AIP-C01 Hands-on Labs: Start Here · Series introduction
  2. AIP-C01 Hands-on Labs: AWS Services Reference · Every AWS service in the series
